set.body:
Owner decisions, 2026-11-08 (verbatim intent, given in chat):
1. Film compiler / film event layer is back in scope now: "it's core and fundamental". Reverses the 2026-09-22 ruling that moved it to 1.1.
2. Triage all unmerged branches: decide what stays, what is good work, what is stale.
3. Rigor: "let's not let the good be the enemy of progress. Our goal is to do engineering work as best we can." Unseen datasets remain for validation, so no excessive ceremony on development work.
4. Consolidate docs into one unified vision and simplify AGENTS.md. Message boards and Fray "didn't serve us well".

Motivation: bd-01M6Y6YK1VD58FE7XPKTY0BSSY shows local content evidence picks the right scene 33.7% of the time vs 61.0% after order decoding; 25% retrieval misses; the symbolic cost terms are constants on Sherlock.

Goal: rich, structured, symbolic mapping of stories, videos and recall-to-video, using all information (annotations, ASR, captions, frames, identity), not mass mapping.

Children: branch triage, docs consolidation + AGENTS.md simplification, north-star plan, then the event-layer phases.
set.title: [unified-path] Consolidate and refocus on a film/recall event layer for symbolic mapping
